instrument_name: IRS Publication 15 (2026) Circular E - scope, farmwork tests, FUTA farmworker tests (local PDF read with PyMuPDF)
article_or_section: What is New (Pub. 15 is for all employers); sec. 5 farmwork; sec. 14 FUTA farmworkers
figure_or_rule_carried: Pub. 15 is for all employers incl. agricultural employers and US territories; Pub. 51, Pub. 80 and Pub. 179 have been DISCONTINUED. Farmwork: all cash wages are subject to FICA and FIT withholding if the employee is paid 150 USD or more in the year OR total farmwork pay (cash and non-cash) to all employees is 2,500 USD or more (period wording of the 2,500 test truncated in my extract: confirm on the page). FUTA farmworkers 2026: cash wages 20,000 USD or more in any calendar quarter of 2025 or 2026, or 10 or more farmworkers on some part of a day in 20 or more different weeks. Household FICA threshold 3,000 USD cash wages in 2026; election workers 2,500 USD. H-2A workers are not statutory employees (W-2 box 13 unchecked). Corrects the pass-2 note that Pub 51 was a 404/unread: Pub 51 is discontinued and Pub 15 carries the rules.
"Publication 51 will no longer be revised -- 23-JAN-2024". Prior revisions listed: 2021, 2022, 2023. Agricultural guidance now lives in Pub. 15 (see US-FED-P5-1-002).

instrument_name: 49 U.S.C. 14503 State and local income taxes of motor carrier employees (LII republication)
figure_or_rule_carried: Compensation of a motor carrier employee who performs regularly assigned duties in 2 or more States is subject to income tax only in the State of the employee residence; an employee is deemed to earn more than 50 percent in a State where time worked is more than 50 percent of total time worked in the calendar year (water carrier/maritime rule differs: residence State plus State where more than 50 percent earned). Effective 1996-01-01 (ICC Termination Act, P.L. 104-88). Read through the WebFetch summarizer: verify subsection letters on the statute page before use in the CCG.

instrument_name: 49 U.S.C. 11502 Rail carrier employee income taxes (LII republication)
figure_or_rule_carried: No part of rail-carrier compensation to an employee with regularly assigned duties on a railroad in more than one State is subject to income tax of any State or subdivision other than the State/subdivision of residence; the carrier files information returns only with the State and subdivision of residence. No 50 percent test in this section (differs from 14503).

instrument_name: 4 U.S.C. 114 Limitation on State income taxation of certain pension income (LII republication)
figure_or_rule_carried: 4 U.S.C. 114 covers RETIREMENT income only (no State may tax retirement income of a non-resident/non-domiciliary). It is NOT a wage-sourcing or mobile-worker day-count statute. No federal statute limiting State taxation of general (non-transport) mobile employees was found; the federal limits located are the transport-sector statutes 49 U.S.C. 14503 and 11502 only. Airline and vessel statutes (49 U.S.C. 40116; 46 U.S.C. 11108) not read.
